g.text: T=400 · 4 paired repetitions/cell · 45 source layouts / 540 cells · 40 methods executed
Each value = 100 × (candidate macro mean / comparator macro mean − 1). Negative means less regret. All-cells primary pools cells equally; balanced secondary weights six source sections equally.
Reduced horizons/arm sets are transformed environments, not the original full-size experiment. Small-n descriptive estimates: no significance stars or superiority claims.
Colors saturate outside ±100%; printed values and CSV retain full magnitudes. Zero comparator means are undefined (—). Nominal paired delta-method intervals are in CSV.
